post.description: Each delivery is a JSON POST with headers D4-Event, D4-Delivery and D4-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<body>">. Answer 2xx within 10 s; failures are retried 5 times over about 7.5 hours, and a webhook is turned off after 5 failed deliveries in a row.
